review_input.original_instruction: You're currently looking into a whiteboard. Turn around, and face right. Take a step forward to the wooden desk, passing the double glass doors on your left. Turn slightly to the right. Take a step forward to the wooden news stand, holding a pile books. Turn around, and face right. Take a step forward, passing a long tan table with a potted plant on top. Take another step forward, keeping that long tan desk to the right of you. Slightly in front of you, you see a white bookshelf. Take two steps forward, passing the white bookshelf on your left. Now, turn around and face right. You see a white computer desktop on a tan desk. Take a step forward to your left. Once you're standing slightly in front of, to the left of a black computer chair connected to a tan desk with a silver computer desktop on top of it, you're done.
